title: Ideation session
prompt: [MEETING] Ideation session — company week 2, day 6 (2026-08-02). FIRST call list_issues: if the backlog already holds more than 8 cards, create NOTHING new this cycle — instead improve, merge or sharpen existing cards and say so. A backlog nobody can build is waste. Then run the ideation session: read BOARD_BRIEF.md, VISION.md and the current src/, then convene the designer and architect (agent tools) around the question 'what would make this product noticeably better for its users?'. Bring at least 3 concrete ideas, argue them against the brief, keep the best one or two and file them with create_github_issue including the value case. Save the minutes.
